propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the pipeline-coverage and renewal-risk dashboards used in the regional sales directors' Monday forecast call.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the dashboards and the reference check confirms them in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained round-robin lead assignment and updated territory rules for the inbound sales team.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the routing and territory work and the former manager confirmed the lead-assignment rules.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate holds the Salesforce Certified Administrator credential.
propositions.rationale: The only material offered for the credential is a completion certificate for an exam-preparation course from a training provider; completing a preparation course is not holding the credential, and the qualification rule forbids upgrading a certification beyond explicit cited evidence.

expectedGap: The Salesforce Certified Administrator credential is not established; the work sample is a completion certificate for an exam-preparation course.
expectedBoundaryNote: Describe the course as a completed preparation course and keep the documented CRM data-quality, dashboard, routing and commission work; do not describe the candidate as a certified administrator.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has sat the Salesforce Certified Administrator exam and, if the credential has been awarded, for the credential ID or verification link.
